item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time for this appointment (end of its time window). Arriving after this time is not allowed; the planned arrival at the stop must be no later than this time.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations in the instance including the warehouse and all stands; equals the number of item entries. The route must visit each stand once and return to the warehouse.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the warehouse (the depot) where the crew leaves from and returns to; this value must match one of the item location_id entries.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this location (either a stand or the warehouse). Used to reference the place in the tour and must match the depot when this item is the warehouse.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map used to compute driving distances between locations (together with the y coordinate).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map used to compute driving distances between locations (together with the x coordinate).

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival time at this stand for restocking; if the crew arrives earlier they may wait until this time. For the warehouse this may be zero or unused.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time at this stand by which restocking must occur; arriving after this time is not permitted.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations the driver must consider, including the medical waste facility (depot) plus every clinic; defines how many nodes the route must visit (size of the problem).

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the medical waste facility node where the driver departs from and must return to; this ID matches one of the location node_id values and denotes the route start/end.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this location (clinic or facility). Used to specify visit order and to match entries to the depot/global count; each clinic node_id must be visited exactly once.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map (in the same spatial units used to compute travel distances). Used to determine travel legs between locations (for example via Euclidean or other distance calculation consistent with the provided distances).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map (in the same spatial units used to compute travel distances). Paired with the X coordinate to compute leg distances between nodes.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival time at this clinic for the medical waste pickup. The driver may arrive earlier and wait, but service cannot occur before this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time at this clinic for the medical waste pickup. The driver must arrive no later than this time to serve the clinic; visiting after this time violates the time window constraint.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations the detailer must visit that day, counting the garage (depot) plus every driveway that must be serviced exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the garage (the depot) where the route must start in the morning and end at the conclusion of the day.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location: either the garage or a customer's driveway; used to reference stops when building the route.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the map (in the same Cartesian coordinate system used for all locations); used to compute driving distance to other locations.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the map (in the same Cartesian coordinate system used for all locations); used with the x coordinate to compute driving distance between stops.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival time for servicing this driveway (the start of the customer's requested time window). The detailer may arrive earlier and wait, but service must begin no earlier than this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time for servicing this driveway (the end of the customer's requested time window). The detailer must arrive at or before this time to complete the job.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations in the run, including the grocery store (the depot) and every customer doorstep; tells the planner how many nodes must appear in the tour.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the depot node — the grocery store where the truck departs and to which it must return. This value matches one of the location node_id values.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the store or a customer doorstep). The planner orders these IDs to form the delivery sequence; every customer location_id must be visited exactly once.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's x coordinate in the planar coordinate system used for the instance (e.g., miles or other distance units). These coordinates, together with y, are used to compute travel distance between consecutive stops when summing total miles.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's y coordinate in the same coordinate system as x; used with x to compute straight-line travel distances between stops for the route distance calculation.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival time at this location (the start of the customer's requested delivery window). The driver may arrive earlier and wait, but the actual delivery time must be no earlier than this value.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time at this location (the end of the customer's requested delivery window). The driver must arrive and deliver no later than this time; arriving after this time violates the customer's window.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations in this run, counting the office (depot) plus every meter site that must be visited exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the office (depot) node where the meter reader must start and finish the route.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location in the route list — either a meter site or the office — used to reference that stop when planning the loop.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the site on the map (in the same spatial coordinate system used to compute distances between stops).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the site on the map (in the same spatial coordinate system used to compute distances between stops).

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the meter reader is allowed to arrive at this site; arriving earlier is permitted only by waiting until this time (times use the same units as travel/time calculations for the instance).

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest time the meter reader must arrive at this site; any arrival after this time would violate the site's access window.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations the cleaning crew must visit, including the company office (depot) and all client homes. Used to size and validate the route (every location must appear exactly once in the tour).

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The node_id that identifies the company office where the crew departs from and must return to. This value matches one of the location_id entries and marks start/end of the tour.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either a client home or the office). This ties together the coordinates and time window for that address and is referenced in the tour order; the office uses the same kind of identifier as clients.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: The x coordinate of the location in a planar coordinate system used to compute travel distances. Together with the y coordinate, this defines the position from which pairwise travel distances (kilometers) between stops are computed.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: The y coordinate of the location in the same planar coordinate system as x; paired with x to compute straight-line travel distances used to sum total kilometers driven for the route.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: The earliest time the crew is permitted to arrive at this household. The crew may arrive earlier and wait, but service is considered started only at or after this time. Times use the same clock/unit across all locations.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: The latest permitted arrival time at this household; arriving after this time violates the household's booking window. All arrival times must be within [earliest_allowed_arrival, latest_allowed_arrival].

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of map locations the rep must consider that day, including the branch office (depot) plus all prospect stops; used to know how many nodes must appear in the tour.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifier for the depot node corresponding to the branch office where the sales representative starts the day and must return at the end.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location (either the branch office or a prospect). Each prospect location_id must be visited exactly once in the planned day; the depot location_id denotes the branch.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's x coordinate on the map used to compute travel distances between stops (coordinates are in the same units as the distance metric).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's y coordinate on the map used to compute travel distances between stops (coordinates are in the same units as the distance metric).

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: The earliest time the prospect is available for a meeting; if the rep arrives before this time they may wait, but the meeting must not start earlier than this value.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: The latest time the prospect's meeting window allows arrival; the rep must arrive at the location no later than this time to satisfy the prospect's slot.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations the researcher must consider, including the basecamp (depot) and every survey site; used to confirm the number of site entries that follow.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the basecamp node where the researcher starts and finishes the route; this node must be the tour start and end point.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this survey site (or the basecamp when applicable); used to reference the site in the tour ordering and to ensure each site is visited exactly once.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the site on the map (in a consistent unit, e.g., kilometers or meters); used, together with coord_y, to compute travel distances between sites for minimizing total driving.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the site on the map (matching the same unit as coord_x); combined with coord_x to determine distances for each leg of the researcher’s route.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival time at this site when sampling may begin; the researcher may arrive earlier and wait, but the actual visit must start no earlier than this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival time at this site by which sampling must occur; arrivals after this time violate the site’s allowed sampling window.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of locations to consider for the day's circuit, including the flower shop (depot) and all delivery addresses; a solver uses this to know how many stops must be visited exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the shop (the route's start and end point). The tour must depart from and return to this node.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this stop (either the shop or a delivery address). Used to reference and order stops in the route.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: Map x-coordinate for this stop (e.g., east-west position on the delivery map). Distances between stops are computed from these coordinates.

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Map y-coordinate for this stop (e.g., north-south position on the delivery map). Together with location_x, it determines driving distance between stops.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the recipient will accept their bouquet at this stop. The route may arrive earlier and wait, but service cannot occur before this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowable arrival time for delivery at this stop. The solver must ensure arrival (after waiting if needed) falls no later than this time.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of stops the counselor must consider, including the service center (depot) and every household on the roster. Use this to size lists and verify every household is planned for exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the service center (the counselor's home base). This location is the start and end point of the round trip and appears among the listed locations.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for each location (each household or the service center). Used to reference the stop when ordering visits and computing the tour.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's x coordinate on the common map coordinate system. Paired with y_coordinate to compute travel distance between stops (distance metric is derived from these coordinates).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's y coordinate on the common map coordinate system. Together with x_coordinate, used to calculate distances for the travel-distance minimization objective.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: The earliest time the household is available for a meeting on the shared time scale. The counselor may arrive earlier and wait, but the visit cannot start before this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: The latest time by which the counselor must arrive to meet the household on the same common time scale. Arrivals after this time are not allowed and would violate the schedule.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of stops the van must account for, including the depot and every distribution point. Use this to size the route (number of distinct locations the tour must visit once).

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the depot where the charity van departs from and returns to. This ID matches one of the location entries and denotes the required start and end of the single loop.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location entry (either the depot or a distribution point). The van must visit each location_id exactly once (with the depot visited at start and finish).

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the city map used to compute travel distance to other locations (e.g., in the same coordinate units as y; typically used with y to compute leg distances such as Euclidean distance).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the city map used together with x to determine distances between stops for the route distance minimization.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the distribution point will accept deliveries (the van may arrive earlier and wait). Times are on a common clock (e.g., minutes or hours from a reference) and the van's arrival must be >= this value to serve the site.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest time the distribution point will accept deliveries. The van must arrive no later than this time to serve the site; arrival times outside this window are invalid for that location.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of stops the tutor must consider for the day, including every student's home plus the tutoring center (the starting and ending location).

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the tutoring center node where the tutor begins the route and must return at the end; this id matches one of the location entries.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a location entry — either a specific student's home or the tutoring center. Used to reference that stop in the route.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's x coordinate on the map (used with the y coordinate to compute travel distances between consecutive stops).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: The location's y coordinate on the map (used with the x coordinate to compute travel distances between consecutive stops).

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: The earliest time the tutor is allowed to arrive for the appointment at this location (the tutor may arrive earlier and wait until this time before starting the appointment).

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: The latest time the tutor is allowed to arrive at this location; the tutor must reach the student's home no later than this time to keep the appointment.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of locations the plan must account for, counting the yard (depot) plus every worksite. The solver uses this to know how many nodes must appear in the tour.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the yard/depot node where the repair crew departs from and must return to. This value matches one of the location_id entries and denotes the route's start and end point.

item_fields.name: node_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific stop (a worksite or the depot). Used to refer to that location when sequencing stops in the tour.

item_fields.name: x
item_fields.scenario_description: X coordinate of the location on the site map. Together with coord_y this is used to compute travel distance between any two stops (the distance metric assumed by the solver).

item_fields.name: y
item_fields.scenario_description: Y coordinate of the location on the site map. Together with coord_x this is used to compute travel distance between any two stops.

item_fields.name: tw_start
item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest allowed arrival (start of the service time window) at this location. The crew may arrive earlier and wait, but service cannot start before this time.

item_fields.name: tw_end
item_fields.scenario_description: Latest allowed arrival (end of the service time window) at this location. The crew must begin service by this time; arriving after this makes the route infeasible for that stop.
